method: weighted actual-hour DHNx design; adaptive full-year fixed-network LP validation
design_global_optimality: not proven for the full-year investment problem
design_loads: actual unscaled load vectors; clustering approximates annual design costs
annual_operation: all original hours; exact duplicate states solved once and restored
pipe_units_assumed: kW capacity; kW/m constant heat loss; EUR/m initial cost
pipe_capacity: cap_max of selected type; cap_min is not a minimum hourly flow
pipe_direction: DHNx actual input/output bounds retained; consumer branches directed
pipe_types: one type per route; at least one DN-30 and one DN-50 installed
losses: constant for every installed pipe in all hours, including zero-flow hours
time_coupling: none; no storage, ramping or changing hourly prices
hydraulics: not calculated; validation checks thermal flows, not pressures or temperatures
